criteria.text: The response concludes that Glenox's indemnity of Protoux under the Data Processing Addendum, which extends to regulatory fines, is not subject to the License Agreement's 12-month-fees liability cap and so leaves Glenox with uncapped exposure. It identifies where this arises (License Agreement Section 11.3(b) or DPA Section 9.2), explains why this matters to Glenox, and recommends a fix.

The response concludes that the sale of Glenox to Sennford Resources Corp. described in the notice letter is a Change of Control of Licensee. It also concludes that this requires Protoux's prior written consent, which Glenox has not sought. It identifies where this arises (License Agreement Section 15.2 or the notice letter), explains why this matters to Glenox, and recommends a fix.

The response concludes that Protoux may assign the License Agreement to any person without Glenox's consent, while Glenox cannot assign without Protoux's consent. It identifies where this arises (License Agreement Section 15.1), explains why this matters to Glenox, and recommends a fix.

The response concludes that the side letter's exclusivity covenant, read with the License Agreement's definition of Covered Operations, extends to the operations of Glenox and all its Affiliates wherever located, beyond the single Rochester Licensed Site. It identifies where this arises (Side Letter Section 2 or License Agreement Section 1), explains why this matters to Glenox, and recommends a fix.

The response concludes that the Order Form subscription automatically renews for successive five-year (60-month) Renewal Terms unless non-renewal notice is given at least 120 days before the end of the then-current term. It identifies where this arises (Order Form Section 4), explains why this matters to Glenox, and recommends a fix.
The response states that the Annual Subscription Fee is $480,000.
The response states that the Initial Subscription Term is 60 months (five years).
The response is written as a memo addressed to the supervising partner.
For each issue it lists, the response states the document and section where the issue appears, why it matters for Glenox, and a recommended fix.
The response claims that Glenox's indemnity under the Data Processing Addendum is capped at the fees paid or payable in the preceding 12 months.
The response claims that Glenox's October 20, 2026 notice letter obtains or satisfies Protoux's consent to the Change of Control.
